title: Hamiltonicity of a regular graph plus a random 2-regular graph
statement: Let $G$ be an $n$-vertex regular graph, and let $F\sim G_{n,2}$ be a random $2$-regular graph on the same vertex set as $G$. Here, $G\cup F$ denotes the graph formed by adding the edges of $F$ to $G$, and **Hamiltonicity conjecture.** With high probability, $G\cup F$ is Hamiltonian. This asks whether the approximate-regularity hypothesis in the cited theorem can be strengthened to regular graphs without any further assumptions; it is presented as an open problem.
source_name: Nemanja Draganić and Peter Keevash, “Pósa rotation through a random permutation”, arXiv:2502.00489 (2025).
